claims.statement: No current finding is published for Circumvention demand because the source status is stale.

method.summary: Bridge users = demand for unlisted entry points (the demand-to-circumvent series). Relay users = direct reachability, structurally near-floor behind the GFW. A transport halving while another surges (transport_shifts) is the public fingerprint of a new GFW classifier deployment. Estimates are Tor's, from sampled directory requests; transport rows keep Tor's low/high bounds. No probe traffic is generated by this collector.

limitations: Current finding withheld: freshness deadline has passed
Bridge-user values are privacy-preserving estimates and should not be read as exact people or devices.
